config.recommended_runtime: CPU runtime, High-RAM (8 vCPU) if available; no GPU is used

deviations: rf_bands swept over [16, 12, 10, 8, 6, 4] and rf_tau over ['fixed', 'scaled'] (scaled: tau = 15.0(K-1)/15); band centres stay linspace(25, 475 kHz, K); every other core.Config field is the frozen value

routers retrained per (condition, model seed, K config) with the frozen train_one recipe; train_one re-expressed with a config argument and frames shared across K; equality with the reference train_one is asserted at K=16
only the 'spike' router per K and one FFT-1024 router per (condition, seed) are trained (train_one also trains analog_delta, unused)
held-out single-class router test streams use NEW seed stages 12/13 (unused by the pilot)
evaluation streams use the pilot formula derive(20|30, cond, seed, case, trial); trials 0-3 = pilot/regression panel, 4 new trial(s) per cell
float64 functional model, not the Q1.17/Q20 hardware; the 2-multiplier biquad form and fixed point are checked separately
whole-bank skip counted by a copy of gates.lazy with one extra counter (equality of all frozen counters asserted per stream)
work figures are operation counts, not energy; KV260 energy comes from the board
selection_rule: Acceptable: in BOTH conditions and for BOTH receiver policies, the upper 95% bootstrap bound of the paired pooled BLER difference to K16_ref (same streams, same RS words) stays below the pilot tolerance (+1 pp), and undetected wrong words do not exceed K16_ref. Among acceptable configs the smallest dense rotation work (4K) wins; tie -> lower gated update fraction. The per-cell gate and the K16_reseed retraining control are reported, not used for selection. Stated before the run; no tuning after it.
